data.title: Agent Tracing
data.tagline: Correlating observable model calls, tool execution and handoffs within a task.
data.description: A report assistant retrieves, reads files and generates. A trace helps distinguish retrieval failure, a tool error and interrupted generation.
data.learningOutcome: Record task and step identifiers, status and timing. Define redaction and access scope before collecting content.

data.boundary: Traces expose recorded events, not guaranteed access to internal reasoning. Raw inputs and outputs may contain private data.
data.agentPrompt: Record correlated task and call identifiers, status, timing and redacted errors. Identify the failing step and recovery options. Restrict log access; never record keys or retain sensitive bodies by default.
